_about: Project setup for the permits tab. Each type points at the company's own permit form (Word .docx); hazards and precautions are read from the form by permit.py settings. Numbers: one base number per week for each series, a letter per permit within the week (e.g. 138 A, 138 B); the week runs Saturday to Friday.
